verdict.rationale: Qodo's portal Configurations page sets organization-level defaults that apply to all connected repositories, and repository-level settings override them centrally (qodo-docs-10, qodo-docs-35, qodo-docs-50). Config-as-code via .pr_agent.toml at org, group, project or repo level and a centralized rule system add hierarchy for enforcing standards across every repository at scale (qodo-docs-11, qodo-docs-12, qodo-docs-38). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration at hundreds-of-repos scale, and documentation of a central view or audit of which repos carry overrides, or of bulk exception management.
